rules.title: Reconnaissance followed by an SSH attack
rules.recommended_action: Block the source address, then check whether any SSH login succeeded

rules.title: An unknown device joined the network and immediately scanned it
rules.recommended_action: Identify the device physically before allowing it to stay on the network

rules.title: Gateway impersonation combined with a DNS redirect
rules.recommended_action: Pin the gateway ARP entry and restore the trusted DNS servers

rules.title: Root logged in over SSH and then did something never seen before
rules.recommended_action: Review the process timeline for that host before the session ends

rules.title: Repeated authentication failures from one source
rules.recommended_action: Check whether any login later succeeded, then block the source address

rules.title: A device is being reconfigured repeatedly
rules.recommended_action: Confirm the change was planned; if not, compare against the last known-good configuration

rules.title: A device keeps restarting
rules.recommended_action: Check the device's power and load before treating it as an attack

rules.title: A probe keeps losing log records
rules.recommended_action: A repeated gap is either a failing probe or someone clearing logs — check the endpoint directly, not only its logs
